import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	reader := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
	writer := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer writer.Flush()

	var n, k int64
	fmt.Fscan(reader, &n, &k)

	nn := n
	var ex int64 = 1

	for n%10 == 0 {
		n /= 10
		k--
	}

			n /= 5
			k--
		} else {
			break
		}
	}

	for k > 0 {
		ex *= 10
		k--
	}

	fmt.Fprintln(writer, ex*nn)
}
